topic.title: Eligibility question: participant under 18
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hello David and the Enveda / Kaggle team,

I am under 18 and currently participating in this competition as part of a team. I could not find an explicit age requirement in the competition-specific rules, so I would like to confirm before the team merger deadline:

  1. Am I allowed to participate and stay on a team as a minor?
  2. If yes, is anything required from me (for example parental or guardian consent)?
  3. If my team finished in a prize position, would my age affect the team's eligibility?

I want to make sure I do not put my teammates at risk. Thank you for your help.
